rationale: Medical applications directed at patients (often elderly or non-tech-savvy) must exude trust, warmth, and absolute clarity. The 'Organic & Earthy' archetype is selected to remove the cold, sterile 'tech/hospital' feel, replacing it with a calming, human-centric aesthetic. Flat, solid surfaces are prioritized over glassmorphism to ensure absolute legibility of medical data.

headings.usage: Use for marketing page headers, the doctor's presentation, and major dashboard section titles. DO NOT use generic sans-serif for H1/H2.

body.usage: Use for all patient data, forms, and instructional text. Manrope provides excellent legibility for older demographics.

rules: H1 (Hero): text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with tracking-tight
Body: text-lg for marketing (better readability), text-base for dashboards
Never use pure black or pure white except for specific surface contrasts. Neutral grays are tinted warm (bone/sand).
Use #1A2942 (Deep Navy) for primary buttons and high-emphasis elements.
Use #C86444 (Warm Terracotta) for secondary/highlight actions (e.g., Book Video Consult).
Text must meet APCA contrast standards. Dark text on light backgrounds is preferred.
NO teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

marketing_page.structure: Bento Grid (Mode A) + Generous Vertical Spacing
marketing_page.hero: Asymmetric layout. Text on the left, impactful imagery on the right with organic soft rounded corners (rounded-3xl).
marketing_page.about_doctor: Large portrait image (max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none) paired with a bold Serif quote.

dashboard_patient.structure: High Density Grid (Mode B) but with larger fonts.
dashboard_patient.spacing: p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
dashboard_patient.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border (#E2DCD0) and shadow-sm. NO glassmorphism.
dashboard_patient.navigation: Sidebar or prominent top nav with large, clear icons and text.

dashboard_doctor.structure: Functional, list/table heavy. Full width container with max-w-7xl.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid (Solid background, 1px subtle border, no shadow). NEVER use glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction of clinical data.
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-2xl for marketing, rounded-xl for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, ambient shadows (shadow-sm) only on hover for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the marketing hero background to remove digital flatness.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for marketing, slightly rounded (rounded-lg) for dashboard. High contrast focus states.
components.forms: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Inputs must have large padding (p-4), large text (text-base or text-lg to prevent mobile zoom), and explicit borders.
components.file_upload: Massive dropzone area with clear dashed borders, a prominent icon (lucide-react), and large instructional text. Must support multi-file easily.
components.cards: Avoid overusing standard 'Cards'. Use raw divs with backgrounds and padding. When using cards in dashboards, keep them flat.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav with solid background (e.g. bg-[#F9F8F6] with border-b). NO transparent headers.
components.toast: Use `sonner` for all success/error notifications (e.g., 'Referti caricati con successo').

motion.philosophy: Minimal, reassuring motion. The demographic needs stability.
motion.entrance: Fade-in up (framer-motion, y: 10, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.4s).
motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase on cards/buttons.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 for buttons/links. Avoid transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Strict minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Verify buttons.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.target_size: Minimum 44x44px for all clickable elements, crucial for elderly users.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-reports-button', data-testid='login-submit').

media.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Use rounded corners (rounded-3xl) for marketing photos. Do not use generic overlays; use subtle gradients if text contrast is needed.

hero_empathy.description: Doctor consulting patiently with patient - use in Hero section

about_doctor.description: Young male doctor portrait (Specializzando in medicina interna) - use in 'Chi Sono' section

clinical_records.description: Doctor writing on a chart/dossier - use in 'Come Funziona' or 'Servizi' section

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute ALL designs in Italian ('Il tuo riassunto clinico', 'Chi sono', 'Carica Referti', 'Prenota Consulto').
Set up Tailwind colors using the specified Hex codes as CSS variables in index.css.
Install and use Google Fonts: 'Playfair Display' for Headings and 'Manrope' for Body.
Build a Marketing Landing Page with Hero, About the Doctor, Pricing (50€ Revisione + 50€ Consulto Video), and a clear CTA to Register/Login.
Implement Google Auth + Email login UI forms.
Create a Patient Dashboard where they can upload multiple images (referti), see dossier status, and book a video consult.
Create a Doctor Dashboard to view patient lists, review uploaded images, upload the summary PDF, and manage availability slots.
DO NOT use generic centered text for paragraphs. Left-align for readability.
Use lucide-react for all icons. Ensure they are large and clearly recognizable.
Every interactive element MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Use Shadcn UI components but override border radii and padding to match the generous spacing system.
Ensure Header has a SOLID background. NO transparent headers over content.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT use glass-morphism for this specific medical app (override standard rule to ensure data clarity). Use flat solid surfaces.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped for marketing, rounded-lg for dashboards) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
